description: 雷蒂改良KIA A07 — 练习：谁的空间更有价值？

intro.popup_en:
Space Cramp, Practice 10 (Advanced Review)
Black has central space with pawns on e5 and d4; White has queenside space with a4-a5 and Nc4. Which space is more valuable? Space matters when it can be converted into an attack.
intro.popup:
空间挤压 练习10（高级综合）

这是最复杂的问题：

黑方有中心空间（e5，d4）
白方有翼侧空间（a4-a5，Nc4）

谁的空间更有价值？
能转化为进攻的空间才是真优势！

outro.popup_en: White's queenside space has greater attacking potential: a5-b4-b5 can open the b-file, and Nc4 is a strong outpost. Black's center is solid but static: d4 locks the position and blocks White's Bg2, but neither side can easily advance there. Space that can be converted into active play is the more valuable space.
outro.popup:
空间价值判断

白方翼侧空间更有转化潜力：
a5，b4，b5→打开b-线
Nc4是翼翼的强马

黑方中心稳固但静止：
d4锁中心→无推进可能
Bg2被封→攻击力减弱

可以转化的空间才是优势！

moves.popup_en: Nf3! The Réti Opening develops the knight first rather than occupying the center immediately.
moves.popup:
Nf3！雷蒂开局！
不急于占中心，先发展马

moves.popup_en: g3 prepares Bg2 in a hypermodern setup.

moves.popup: c5 黑方再占！加强中心控制
moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black claims more central space and strengthens central control.
Bg2! White's hypermodern bishop targets the central square d5 from the long diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bg2！白方的超现代武器！
从g2瞄准中心d5格

e5！黑方推e5！
黑方现在有c5+d5+e5的大中心！
moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black advances and establishes a broad center with pawns on c5, d5, and e5.

moves.popup: d3 稳固，不急于争中心
moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes White's position without rushing to challenge the center.
e4! White challenges Black's broad center and begins the central confrontation.
...d4!! Black closes the center. This blocks White's bishop on g2, but the locked structure also restricts both sides' ability to advance.
moves.popup:
d4！！黑方关门！

黑方封住了中心——
优势：白方Bg2被d4完全封锁！
代价：中心锁死，双方无法推进，活动受限

a4！白方转向翼侧！
中心既然锁了，就去翼侧找机会
moves.popup_en: a4! With the center locked, White turns to the flank to seek opportunities.
Nc4! White establishes a strong outpost. The knight may target d6 or support the queenside plan a5-b4-b5. White's flank space now has a concrete purpose.
moves.popup:
Nc4！⭐白方的强格！

Nc4攻击d6（若黑方有d6）
或配合a5-b4-b5进攻

翼侧空间开始有了具体计划！

moves.popup_en: ...Qc7 reinforces Black's position and may prepare a ...b5 counterbreak.
a5!! White fixes the queenside structure. White can expand with a4-a5 and Nc4, then prepare b4-b5; Black's e5-d4 center is solid but static. Which side has space that can be turned into an attack?
moves.popup:
a5！！白方锁定翼翼！

现在：
白方：a4-a5+Nc4，翼侧扩张并有具体进攻
黑方：e5+d4，中心稳固但静止

⭐ 练习问题：
谁的空间更有进攻价值？
白方a5-b4-b5打开b线 vs 黑方……能推进吗？
